idea: This DC Metro station from my photos

research.reasoning: Photos show the standard WMATA coffered vault; the specific station is not identifiable, which the composition does not need.

searches.query: Washington Metro coffered vault station design platform length

uncertainties: Station dimensions are typical values (600 ft platform, about 30 m vault span), not measured for this station.
sheet.subject: Washington Metro coffered-vault station interior
sheet.summary: A standard WMATA side-platform station under the Harry Weese coffered concrete vault, from the user photos; the specific station is not identified.
sheet.proportions: Very long vault about 6:1 length to span; the vault crown is about 0.6 of the span above the track.
distinctive: Silver railcars with a red-white-blue stripe
sheet.hero: View along the platform as in the first photo.
sheet.layout: x along the tracks; +z front; the left track as photographed is the back track (low z).

design.reasoning: Target 46 x 8 x 12 is very shallow; deepened to 12 studs so both platforms fit. Open-front section so both track beds show.

scene.d: A coffered concrete vault over two tracks with side platforms, edge lights and a silver train on the left track; the front is left open to show both track beds.
f: Silver train on the left track

review.reasoning: Compared views with both photos; front is open.

revision.evidence: No revision was requested for this first build.

composition.evidence: The photos show a full barrel vault spanning both tracks; the model vault stops above the left track, so the right track is uncovered.

review.summary: Platforms, edge lights and the train read; the vault is a partial section with small coffers.

Coffered barrel vault.evidence: Stepped bands with small notches; not a barrel spanning both tracks.

Two side platforms.evidence: Brown platforms at the back and front (view 5).

improvements: Coffered vault: continue the bands down to the front platform so the vault spans both tracks.
Coffers: deepen the recesses to two plates so the waffle pattern reads.

The coffered vault spans both tracks.evidence: Vault ends above the left track.

judge.summary: Vault coverage is the critical failure.
